theme: 3 SwiftUI terms for effects that react to scrolling and appearing

terms.definition: A modifier that changes how a view looks based on its position, without changing its layout.
terms.example: Use visualEffect to blur cards near the edge.

terms.definition: A modifier that changes a view while it scrolls into or out of the visible area.
terms.example: Add scrollTransition so the cards fade at the edges.

terms.definition: Your own type that decides how a view looks as it appears and disappears.
terms.example: Write a Custom Transition for the popup.

video.title: visualEffect, scrollTransition & Custom Transition | Day 180
video.description:
Learn to explain how SwiftUI views react while they scroll and appear: visualEffect, scrollTransition & Custom Transition, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
visualEffect - A modifier that changes how a view looks based on its position, without changing its layout.
scrollTransition - A modifier that changes a view while it scrolls into or out of the visible area.
Custom Transition - Your own type that decides how a view looks as it appears and disappears.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: SwiftUI visualEffect, scrollTransition & Custom Transition | Day 180
landscape.description:
Explain visualEffect, scrollTransition & Custom Transition in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
비주얼이펙트, 스크롤트랜지션, 커스텀 트랜지션 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

visualEffect - A modifier that changes how a view looks based on its position, without changing its layout.
한국어: 비주얼이펙트: 레이아웃은 바꾸지 않고 뷰의 위치에 따라 모양을 바꾸는 모디파이어

scrollTransition - A modifier that changes a view while it scrolls into or out of the visible area.
한국어: 스크롤트랜지션: 뷰가 화면 안팎으로 스크롤될 때 모양을 바꾸는 모디파이어

Custom Transition - Your own type that decides how a view looks as it appears and disappears.
한국어: 커스텀 트랜지션: 뷰가 나타나고 사라질 때의 모습을 직접 정하는 타입

In this video, Mina and Jake add fading cards and a blur effect to a scroll view, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain visualEffect, scrollTransition and Custom Transition in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want cards that fade when they leave the screen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use scrollTransition. It changes a view while it scrolls in or out.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I know where the card is?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The scrollTransition gives you a `phase`. When `phase.isIdentity` is true, the card is fully on screen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. I also want a blur that depends on the position.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a job for visualEffect. It gives you the view and its geometry.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is visualEffect better than a GeometryReader?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Often yes, because it does not change the layout of the view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wrote a fade, but I want the same look when views appear.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How does a Custom Transition know the state?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It gets the same kind of `phase`, and you change the view for each one.
Use visualEffect to blur cards near the edge.
